Ruling A2 (oracle xianyuyijinban, 2026-09-27; one decision covering 5kR1/5kR2): exception. AR03BTCX5001 is a Viking AR03 precision thin-film 0603 resistor; its trailing 5001 is the E-96 four-figure code for 5.00 kohm (500 x 10^1). The board value 5000 ohm is CORRECT; the decoder's 0.03 ohm is absurd (a 0.03 ohm precision thin-film part does not exist) -- decoder gap, filed. Oracle on design knowledge: 5kR1 就是 5KΩ.
Ruling A2 (same batch as 5kR1): exception. Twin part, same MPN, same decoder gap, same reasoning.
